name: forgenotes-recorder-mac
description: ForgeNotes desktop recorder (macOS) — captures mic + BlackHole system audio as separate tracks and uploads them to the ForgeNotes pipeline.

scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare:config && electron-builder --mac --universal && codesign --force --sign - release/ForgeNotes-Recorder.dmg && npm run verify:mac

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ForgeNotes records your microphone and the meeting audio you route through BlackHole.
